{{Quote|You won't disrupt the work I'm doing to stabilize Balmorra|Vekarr|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Vekarr''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who held the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] and tasked with overseeing the [[Gorinth Brig]] prison. When the Brig was infiltrated by a Republic citizen looking to free [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Otak'or Meln]] and Doctor [[Ortis]], Vekarr and his men attacked the intruder, but were defeated.
